acceptance.operation: One named range registered before inference; count original native GPU weight loads in both graph phases.
acceptance.coverage: Each of the 2097152 halfs touched at least once in each phase. Compare independent per-half counts, per-instruction counts, access width, byte totals and compiled site identities. Report repeated reads.
acceptance.execution: Native control and traced process run sequentially under the existing V3 resource guard, with the same input, model binary and DLLs.
acceptance.measurement_scope: Read coverage and numerical equivalence only; no media-service injection or timing claim.
